subject: de-sptl
title: DE.SPTL.------CR.INFO.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 494 (TRF(II)-30). DE-SPTL (despiritualization) is the subject; CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation), VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and PART (participation). From TR: DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture’s center). From DIS-C-CT: EXP-CONT-2 (expansion condition (isolated focus)). From VT-DY: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From PART: MOT-DY. From MOT-DY: INDIV-TD-2 (individual tendencies).
